v1.fact1: Breakage happens above the scalp. **Alopecia begins below it.**
v1.fact2: Hair is replaceable. **Hair follicles are not.**

v2.myth: “It’ll grow back| if you stop| relaxing your hair.”
v2.fact1: **Scarred follicles do not regrow** from scar tissue.
v2.fact2: Early treatment can help **stop or slow more loss.**

v3.myth: “If it doesn’t itch,| it’s not active.”
v3.fact1: CCCA can be silent. Many people have **no burning, itching, or pain.**

v4.fact1: No single factor explains CCCA. **Tight braids can make scalp inflammation worse.**
v4.fact2: And years of tight styles can cause **traction alopecia.**
